resources.string: Each player steers one round toy sumo with the stick or pad in their own zone. Shove the others out of the ring: the last sumo inside wins the round. Hold Dash to charge, release to shove, then wait for the cooldown. The ring shrinks as the round goes on.
%1$s: dash button. Hold to charge, release to shove. %2$s.
%1$s: thumb-stick. Drag to steer. A screen reader cannot drag: choose One button in the setup.
%1$s: direction pad. Hold a direction to steer. A screen reader cannot hold: choose One button in the setup.
Hold Dash to charge, release to shove. A charged dash is heavy, but then you wait for the cooldown.
The ring shrinks over time. Stay near the middle and let rivals push each other out.
Hard to steer? Turn on Relaxed or One button in the setup.
